TYPE-1 NARRATIVE AND PLANS
FOR THE PROPOSED ZONING CHANGE
AT 3440 S PARNELL AVENUE, CHICAGO, 60616

The Applicant seeks a zoning change from M1-2 (“Manufacturing District”) to RT-4 (Residential
Two-Flat, Townhouse, and Multi-Unit District) to build a 2-dwelling unit property with 2 off street
parking spaces,

NARRATIVE AND PLANS FOR 3440 S Parnell Ave:

ZONING: RT-4

LOT AREA: 3,186 sq ft
MINIMUM LOT AREA PER DWELLING UNIT: 1,593 sq ft
FLOOR AREA RATIO: 1.2

BUILDING AREA: 3,720 sq ft
OFF-STREET PARKING: 2 parking spaces
FRONT SETBACK: 16°-0”

REAR SETBACK: 47-li
COMBINED SIDE SETBACK : 5’-0”
SOUTH SIDE SETBACK IS 3’-0”

NORTH SIDE SETBACK IS 2’-0”
BUILDING HEIGHT: 37-4”

Set of plans is attached.
